# Henry Steinhauer

> Portfolio of Henry Steinhauer, a backend software engineer working with Go on distributed systems, backend services, developer tools and AI-agent skills. A playful, interactive version lives at https://workshop.steinhauer.dev.

## Profiles
- [Interactive workshop](https://workshop.steinhauer.dev): game-like companion to this site
- [GitHub](https://github.com/H3nSte1n): source code and projects
- [Medium](https://medium.com/@henrysteinhauer): engineering notes
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/henry-steinhauer/): professional profile

## Featured projects
- [OAuth 2.0 Provider (Go)](https://github.com/H3nSte1n/go-oauth-provider): token issuance and scope-based access control
- [AI Agent Skills](https://github.com/H3nSte1n/skills): reusable agent skills, including a DevOps skill
- [CI Orchestrator (Go)](https://github.com/H3nSte1n/ci-orchestrator): worker-based build orchestration engine
- [Recipe App (Go)](https://github.com/H3nSte1n/recipe): layered Go backend service with relational persistence
- [Coverage Badge CLI](https://github.com/H3nSte1n/coverage-badge-creator): generates coverage badges for CI pipelines
